test_environment.device: ASUS VivoBook M1403QA (ASUSTeK COMPUTER INC. VivoBook_ASUSLaptop M1403QA_M1403QA)
test_environment.ram: 16 GB Installed (8 GB Micron Technology DDR4-3200, 8 GB Micron Technology DDR4-3200), 15.41 GB Usable
test_environment.storage: INTEL SSDPEKNU512GZ (477 GB SSD, BusType: NVMe, MediaType: SSD)

tests.name: ML-KEM-768 Key Generation
tests.expected: Valid 1184-byte public key and secret key generated

tests.name: ML-KEM-768 Encap/Decap Agreement
tests.expected: Encapsulation and decapsulation produce identical 32-byte shared secret
tests.actual: Decapsulated shared secret matches encapsulated secret byte-for-byte

tests.name: ML-KEM-768 Ciphertext & Secret Nonce Variation
tests.expected: Independent encapsulations produce distinct ciphertexts and shared secrets
tests.actual: Distinct ciphertexts and distinct shared secrets produced

tests.name: ML-KEM-768 Ephemeral Key Uniqueness
tests.expected: Consecutive key generation calls generate unique public keys

tests.name: HKDF Session Key Agreement
tests.expected: Both peers derive identical AES encryption keys given identical inputs
tests.actual: Derived AES encryption keys match byte-for-byte across peers

tests.name: HKDF Classical Secret Dependency
tests.expected: Different classical secrets result in distinct session keys

tests.name: HKDF Post-Quantum Secret Dependency
tests.expected: Different ML-KEM shared secrets result in distinct session keys

tests.name: HKDF Domain Key Separation
tests.expected: Derived encryptionKey and confirmationKey are cryptographically distinct
tests.actual: Encryption key and confirmation key are distinct

tests.name: HMAC Mutual Key Confirmation Verification
tests.expected: Valid HMAC confirmation tag over handshake transcript is verified using derived confirmationKey
tests.actual: HMAC confirmation tag verified successfully with derived confirmationKey

tests.name: HMAC Tampered Handshake Rejection
tests.expected: Tampered handshake payload is rejected during HMAC confirmation using derived confirmationKey
tests.actual: Tampered handshake HMAC successfully rejected with derived confirmationKey

tests.name: AES-GCM-256 Authenticated Encryption/Decryption
tests.expected: Valid plaintext encrypted and decrypted with AAD matches original string

tests.name: AES-GCM-256 Tampered Ciphertext Authentication
tests.expected: Bit-flipped ciphertext fails GCM tag authentication and throws error
tests.actual: Tampered ciphertext rejected by WebCrypto GCM tag check

tests.name: AES-GCM-256 Key Authenticity Verification
tests.expected: Decryption with unassociated AES key fails authentication tag verification

tests.name: AES-GCM-256 Additional Authenticated Data (AAD) Binding
tests.expected: Mismatch in sequence number or direction in AAD causes GCM decryption failure
tests.actual: Decryption with modified AAD sequence rejected

tests.name: Two-Way Chat: Creator to Invitee
tests.expected: Messages sent from Creator are received and decrypted by Invitee across all 3 runs

tests.name: Two-Way Chat: Invitee to Creator
tests.expected: Messages sent from Invitee are received and decrypted by Creator across all 3 runs

tests.name: Signaling Constraint: Third-Peer Rejection
tests.expected: Attempt by a third peer to enter occupied room is rejected with ROOM_FULL across all 3 runs

tests.name: Session Teardown: Room Destroy Cleanup
tests.expected: Explicit room destruction removes all session storage keys across all 3 runs

tests.name: Replay Protection: Envelope Sequence Validation
tests.expected: Envelopes with out-of-order or duplicate sequences rejected
tests.actual: Sequence counter validation enforced at application envelope layer; raw WebRTC packet injection out-of-scope for browser unit tests
